==Polish==

===Etymology===
{{bor+|pl|de|zentrieren}} + {{af|pl|-ować}}.

===Pronunciation===
{{pl-pr|a=LL-Q809 (pol)-Poemat-#.wav}}

===Verb===
{{pl-verb|impf}}

# {{lb|pl|transitive|sports}} to [[center]]; to [[cross]] {{gl|to direct a ball or puck from the side of a court near the goal, towards other players, allowing them to shoot at goal}}
#: {{syn|pl|dośrodkowywać}}
# {{lb|pl|transitive|mechanics}} to [[align]] {{gl|to straighten a wheel by tightening or loosening its spokes}}
#: {{syn|pl|docentrowywać|wycentrowywać}}
# {{lb|pl|transitive|computer technology}} to [[center]], to [[align]] {{gl|to place text or an object in the center of a designated area when working in a computer program}}
#: {{syn|pl|wyśrodkowywać}}
# {{lb|pl|transitive|mechanical engineering}} to [[center]], to [[align]] {{gl|to position two objects so that their centers are located on a common axis}}
# {{lb|pl|transitive|bicycling}} to [[center]], to [[align]] {{gl|to bend a bicycle wheel}}
